## Short philosophy quotes

Brief English renderings selected for clarity. Useful for teaching, journaling, or a first encounter with a thinker.

Every line below is one sentence or less, and every one links to its located source — the work and passage the wording was checked against, where the archive holds one.

### Short lines, long checkability

Brevity is the test this collection applies, and nothing else. The neighbouring collections answer different questions: [famous](https://www.philosophydef.com/quotes/famous) is about historical recognition and [best](https://www.philosophydef.com/quotes/best) is the editors' argument-centred picks. Here the only gate is that the passage fits in a breath and still says something worth thinking about.

A caution worth stating on a page of short quotes: compression is where misquotation begins. Some of the most famous “quotes” in philosophy are short forms that dropped a clause the original argument needed — which is why each entry behind these lines records the wording, the work, and the variants that circulate in its place. If a line is going into print, cite the entry, not the snippet.
